hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang roared in fury.

hunks.baseline: “That bow I just gave you… was my final farewell. I’m leaving now. I’ll go far away and never return.”
hunks.sol: “That bow… was my final farewell. I’m leaving now. I’ll go far away and never return.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang blinked. The ceiling had seemed blurry for a while, but now something was running down his cheek.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang blinked. The ceiling had looked blurry for some time, and now something was running down his cheek.

hunks.baseline: “The inn is old. Rain must be leaking through.”
hunks.sol: “This inn is old. The roof must be leaking.”

hunks.baseline: It had been the night before New Year’s Day.
hunks.sol: It was a winter night, one day before New Year’s Day.
